# The defect predates the report

`customer_support.heu.root_cause_analysis.the_defect_predates_the_report` · v1.0.0 · **draft** · scope **capability** · kind **heuristic**

> Assume the fault has been shipping quietly for far longer than the ticket has existed.


## The heuristic

**Assume the fault has been shipping quietly for far longer than the ticket has existed.**


_Why:_ Reports require a customer to notice, care, and bother — three filters, each of which loses most occurrences. "It started last week" almost always means "we noticed last week", and treating it as an onset date wrecks the timeline.
